parameters.query:
select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'status', status, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) as runs
from demo_runs where created_at >= now() - interval '1 day'
select (select report from demo_runs where status in ('done','partial') order by created_at desc limit 1) as latest
insert into demo_runs (status, scenario, steps) values ('running', $1::jsonb, $2::jsonb) returning id
